**Limitations**

- The paper adds tests on the shape of the USAN to remove false corners. PixelNexus leaves them out.
- Curved edges look like weak corners. On the Disks image it finds 160 corners, almost all along the round edges.
- The 5 x 5 window of the suppression is PixelNexus's choice.

**Artifacts**

- Rows of corners along tight curves and at the ends of thin lines.
